importantNote: Immediate view loading on app start eliminating blank pages, instant automatic logged account & playlist restoration.

items: Enforced immediate initial `loadView` execution on app startup so your account home page, playlists, and songs render instantly without waiting.
Non-blocking background cloud synchronization for user playlists, favorites, and profile data.
Disabled automatic floating update banners and popup overlays to preserve clean, uninterrupted app usage.
Updates now process seamlessly in the background without forcing screens or prompting.
